result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders, so your example comes out as Anna 2, Bob 1.

The change is in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. Its subquery was missing the `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` filter that the other per-rep counts and the per-quarter purchase order report already have. I added that filter and updated the method's Javadoc to say cancelled purchase orders are not counted.

`SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes (3 tests, 0 failures). I did not add a test for the cancelled case, and I did not run the full suite. Nothing is committed.
